name: vernaculus
description: Delegate well-specified coding work to a locally hosted model over MCP, with a diagnose-and-refine loop

interface.shortDescription: Delegate coding work to a local model
interface.longDescription: An MCP adapter for a locally hosted model, plus the brief, generate, verify, diagnose, refine loop that measurement shows it needs. Cold single-shot delegation solved 1 of 3 real functions; the same model solved 3 of 3 once the caller diagnosed the failures.
defaultPrompt: List the models installed on my local Ollama daemon.
Draft this function with the local model, then help me verify it.
The local model's draft fails its tests - help me diagnose the cause.
